newsitem.title: ZAIRE: Zaire opposed to Canadian airdrop plan - minister.
newsitem.headline: Zaire opposed to Canadian airdrop plan - minister.

text.p: Zaire will not accept a U.S.-backed Canadian plan to air-drop food for thousands of refugees and Zaireans fleeing fighting, the government spokesman said on Thursday.
"The Zairean government is categorically opposed to the Canadian proposition to drop foodstuffs for refugees and displaced Zaireans," said spokesman Boguo Makeli, who is the information minister.
Boguo said Zaire was worried about the safety of such airdrops and the fact that they would be staged from neighbouring countries it accuses of aggression.
"Zaire will not authorise overflights of its territory by any aircraft, whichever force it belongs to, for an operation so dangerous for the people concerned," he told Reuters.
Canada, which is leading the U.N.-backed mission to help Rwandan and Burundian refugees in eastern Zaire, has suggested this week that airdrops of food could be made in the area.
The United States said on Wednesday it supported a Canadian proposal to set up a headquarters in neighbouring Uganda for an international force to ease the refugee crisis in Zaire.
